items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: Pastor White, you might say, it was there, you were on the other side

ctx.x: The old Catholic, I was raised a Catholic, and that's the time when the Catholic, I never forget my mother and father at that time, my grandfather was named Bowman, he was shipping commissioner here, what I meant, he had his charge of all the boats that came in from South America, those fruit boats that brought bananas and all the things, all the boats that came in, and they had to go to his office to get okay, and he was well off, there was quite a story behind him before he came to New Orleans, because he was…
I can bum a ride with you.
